arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, sys, os, time, json
env = dict(os.environ)
env['PATH'] = '/usr/local/bin:/nonexistent-bin'   # hides gcc (in /usr/bin)
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'project/solver.py'],
                   stdin=open('/tmp/big3.json','rb'), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                   stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
print('fallback big3 elapsed %.1fs rc=%d' % (time.time()-t, p.returncode))
open('/tmp/fb3.json','wb').write(p.stdout)
a = json.load(open('/tmp/o3.json')); b = json.load(open('/tmp/fb3.json'))
print('identical to accelerated output:', a == b)
env2 = dict(os.environ); env2['PATH'] = '/usr/local/bin:/nonexistent-bin'
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', 'project/solver.py'],
                   stdin=open('/tmp/req2.json','rb'), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, env=env2)
print('small case ok:', p.stdout[:60])
EOF
